question: How can I make an accordion section display expanded by default when the page loads?
ground_truth: To make an accordion section display expanded by default when the page loads, use the `defaultOpen` property set to `true`. For example: `<Accordion title="Section 1" defaultOpen={true}>Content</Accordion>`. This property is useful for highlighting important information or frequently accessed content.

metadata.cited_context: The `defaultOpen` property controls whether the accordion should be open when the page loads. If not specified, the accordion will be collapsed by default. Use the `defaultOpen` property to have specific accordions expanded by default when the page loads. This is useful for highlighting important information or frequently accessed content.
